questions.question: J, K, L, M and N are sitting on a bench. J is the immediate neighbour of K, M is the immediate neighbour of N, and J is not sitting with L who sits on the right end of the bench. J sits to the right of M and N. M sits to the right of N. In which position is J sitting?
questions.solution:
**Given : **

 
• **J, K, L, M and N are sitting on a bench. **
 
• **As the direction is not given, so all of them are facing north is assumed.**

**Explanation :**

1) J is not sitting with L who sits on the right end of the bench.

Here the position of J is not known yet but where J cannot be positioned is given. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/26c4a9b1f7d1b00c23a4dece1dadd78d9d1aaa49d50377d1d318686bbdf57e02.png] 

2) J sits to the right of M and N.

3) M sits to the right of N.

4) M is the immediate neighbor of N.

As where J cannot be positioned is already given, therefore there is only possible position for J. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/049c9b67f2c19fb0201606332a2a25e775121f00f04cf2b9f75a2034d53270ec.png] 

5) J is the immediate neighbor of K.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c5b7d8b8663ba6db5e9e215127a657fb2fecd28caa3b1b3f695b77b9b61c45ab.png] 

Thus, according to the final arrangement J third from the left end.

Hence, **"Third from the left"** is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Eight girls, G1, G2, G3, G4, G5, G6, G7 and G8, are sitting around a circular table facing the centre (not necessarily in the same order). G5 is third to the right of G1. G8is second to the right of G4. G4 is not the immediate neighbour of G1 or G5. G6 and G2are immediate neighbours. G2 is not the immediate neighbour of G1. G7 is not the immediate neighbour of G8.

Which of the following statements is correct?

I. G7 is the immediate left of G4.

II. G1 and G3 are neighbour of G8.

options.text: Neither I nor II is correct.
Both I and II are correct.

questions.solution:
**Given : Eight girls, G1, G2, G3, G4, G5, G6, G7 and G8, are sitting around a circular table facing the centre.**

**Explanation :**

1) G5 is third to the right of G1.

2) G4 is not the immediate neighbour of G1 or G5. 

3) G8 is second to the right of G4.

As G4 is not sitting adjacent either G1 or G5, therefore there is only one possible position for G4 with given position of G8.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ffbdc5ee6f09458d5be61d95f22e9f54647a8e077dc1856bd99e65dbd6a6b1ac.png] 

4) G2 is not the immediate neighbour of G1.

5) G6 and G2are immediate neighbours.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a30c23a465eaad49adbf1a37b24f4ab5eb7bf003161e394050227bee526a1cad.png] 

6) G7 is not the immediate neighbour of G8.

After position G7, only one position is left which will be occupied by the only person left i.e G3.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fee99ce8f488e7a12cf61e2636ca5daaf244587976a39f1407b7712c627c05de.png] 

 

Thus, according to the final arrangement :

I. G7 is the immediate left of G4 - correct

II. G1 and G3 are neighbour of G8 - correct

Here, both the statements are correct.

Hence, **"****Both I and II are correct"** is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

I. All W are A.

II. Some X are W.

**Conclusions:**

I. All X are A.

II. Some W are X.

III. Some A are not X.
questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e2885488013cd53260d5070d55a3b3a7198f40a7e5b0bb3663534b8a9d83ae93.png] 

Conclusions:

I. All X are A → **Does not f**ollow (As some X are W, all W are A. So,it is possible but not definitely true. therefore it Does not follow)

II. Some W are X → Follow (As some X are W. So, it is definitely true)

III. Some A are not X → **Does not follow (There is any** given relation between A and X. It is possible Some X are A. And It is also possible All X are A. So, We can not define the relation. So, the conclusion is not follow )

∴ Here, Only conclusion II follows.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Only conclusion II follows****"**.

questions.question: The volume of 7 spheres V1, V2, V3, V4, V5, V6 and V7 are compared. The volume ofV4 is less than V1, V2 and V5. The volume of V7 is greater than only two spheres. The volume of V4 is more than V7. If the volume of V6 is not the lowest, then the volume of how many spheres is less than V3?
questions.solution:
**Given : The volume of 7 spheres V1, V2, V3, V4, V5, V6 and V7 are compared.**

**Explanation :**

1) The volume of V4 is more than V7.

2) The volume of V7 is greater than only two spheres.

⇒ V4 > V7 > _ > _

3) The volume ofV4 is less than V1, V2 and V5.

⇒ V1/V2/V5 > V4 > V7 > _ > _

4) If the volume of V6 is not the lowest.

⇒ **V1/V2/V5 > V4 > V7 > V6 > V3**

Thus, according to the final arrangement there are zero number of spheres which are less than V3.

Hence, **"0"** is the correct answer.

questions.question:
By interchanging the given two signs + and - and two numbers 17 and 216 (NOT digits), which of the following equations will be correct?

I. 10 × 216 + 17 ÷ 6 - 13 = 146

II. 7 × 216 + 41 - 17 ÷ 36 = 81
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ebadc30a979bf1a7e953d20901c3e7953c575296c0e0bb4af8a458ec3a64ab2c.png] 

According to the question, after interchanging the given two signs and two numbers i.e

__
 
• + and -
 
• two numbers 17 and 216 (NOT digits)

So,

I. 10 × 17 - **216 ÷ 6**__ + 13 = 146

__**10 × 17**__ - 36 + 13 = 146

__**170 + 13**__ - 36 = 146

__**183 - 36**__ = 146

**147 ≠****146** (LHS ≠ RHS)

II. 7 × 17 - 41 + __**216 ÷ 36**__ = 81

__**7 × 17**__ - 41 + 6 = 81

__**119 + 6**__ - 41 = 81

__**125 - 41**__ = 81

**84 **≠ 81 (LHS ≠ RHS)

Here, Neither I nor II is correct.

Hence, "Option - (3)" is the correct answer.
